DH_NICE_SHEETS.Failure: Nice Sheets ran into an error with Daggerheart {version}, so parts of the sheet may be missing, or the system's sheet opens in its place. Until Nice Sheets is updated, switch to the system's sheet with Configure Sheet, in the sheet window's menu. The details are in the browser console (F12).
DH_NICE_SHEETS.ImageTips:
Best art for the sheet

The image also fills the sheet's background, faint and cropped to fit.

  • Portrait shape, taller than wide.
  • Transparent background (PNG or WebP), so only the character shows.
  • Face in the upper third.
  • About 1000 px tall or more.

Wide images lose their sides, and token art shows its round frame.

LevelUp.choicesLeft: Settle the advancement choices to continue

Notes.title: Notes
Notes.placeholder: Write anything here. It saves as you type.

ShowBiography.name: Show the biography under Notes
ShowBiography.hint: Shows the system's biography fields (pronouns, age, faith, background, connections) below the notes in the Notes tab. Hidden by default; this choice is saved on your user.

SuggestSheet.name: Suggest the Nice Sheet to players
SuggestSheet.hint: The first time a player opens their character in another sheet, ask once whether to switch to the Nice Sheet. A player who says no is not asked again.

Offer.title: Try the Nice Sheet
Offer.content: Open {name} in the Nice Sheet? It keeps every roll and action of the system's sheet, with a richer design.
Offer.hint: This changes the sheet of this character for everyone who opens it. You can switch back at any time with Configure Sheet, in the sheet window's menu.

Container.empty: Drag items here to store them
Container.equipped: Equipped items can't go in a container. Unequip it first.
